composition_variation: Develop a luminous original anime illustration of a 30-year-old woman on a narrow coastal path beneath a distant white lighthouse. Her mature, beautiful face combines slightly elongated violet-gray eyes, clean cheekbone definition, a fine nose, and a serene subtle smile. Deep violet hair falls smoothly behind her shoulders and moves in a light breeze. She wears a fully opaque white short-sleeved blouse with a neat folded collar, a sage-green calf-length pleated skirt, tan walking sandals, and a natural straw hat with a plain dark ribbon. She steadies the front edge of the hat using one hand at temple height, keeping the elbow close, while the other arm hangs comfortably with a small woven handbag. Her stance is upright and unhurried, with one foot slightly ahead on the path. Small coastal grasses and pale yellow flowers border the paving, while turquoise sea and pale cliffs recede behind her. Late-morning sunlight creates a soft hat shadow over her forehead without hiding her eyes. Aim for clean refined facial rendering, airy skirt folds, and calm open space. Use an eye-level portrait composition, with one person centered in the middle-to-lower frame and hands held within the central crop. Leave the upper quarter as clean pale sky or light for the lock-screen clock.
